race.comment: MELBOURNE BOY (10) resumes. He ran very well on debut back in April behind subsequent Listed winner Blind Raise, getting a long way back but finishing off strongly for third. No public jumpouts is interesting but if he's firm in the market he looks one to follow, especially over a bit more ground. SAINT FOX (11) is a Frankel colt who ran well on debut at Geelong when in the market, sticking on nicely for third behind a smart winner. Better for that and 1400m will suit ideally. CAJUN (12) resumes having debuted in the ANZAC Day Stakes behind Blind Raise which ties in MELBOURNE BOY. She should be an improver this time around and draws well. JUST LIKE JAGGER (6) has been good in three runs to date but is wearing a bit thin while CAPTAIN REDBEARD (3) made improvement at Seymour and is in the mix.
